title: Asymptotic Stability of Hartree--Fock Homogenous Equilibria in $\mathbb{R}^d$
summary: In this paper, we establish nonlinear Landau damping and asymptotic stability of a large class of translation-invariant steady solutions to the time-dependent Hartree--Fock equations in the presence of an {\em off-diagonal exchange operator}, which arises naturally in the meanfield theory of a large fermionic system, in the whole space $\mathbb{R}^d$, $d\ge 3$.
